items.summary: I handle customer support, too, and I was getting 50+ emails daily. Even on Monday morning, I would find 80+ sitting there because of the weekend off. items.headline: Vecchia-Inducing-Points Full-Scale Approximations for Gaussian Processes
items.summary:
arXiv:2507.05064v4 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Gaussian processes are flexible, probabilistic, non-parametric models widely used in machine learning and statistics. However, their scalability to large data sets is limited by computational constraints. To overcome these challenges, we propose Vecchia-inducing-points full-scale (VIF) approximations combining the strengths of global inducing points and local Vecchia approximations. items.headline: MatClaw: An Autonomous Code-First LLM Agent for End-to-End Materials Exploration
items.summary:
arXiv:2604.02688v3 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Existing LLM agents for computational materials science are constrained by pipeline-bounded architectures tied to specific simulation codes and by dependence on manually written tool functions that grow with task scope.
